verdict.rationale: First-party CLI docs say you can start Codex in a repository to explore unfamiliar code and plan a change, and it can inspect files in your local repository. It can also split a larger investigation across subagents and accept architecture diagrams as prompt context, which together cover finding where to begin a change. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how codebase exploration or architecture explanation works (e.g., codebase maps, symbol or dependency tracing), and independent hands-on corroboration of codebase-understanding quality.
